meta.name: capital-allocation
meta.description: Evaluates where to spend limited capital — investment appraisal, hurdle rates, payback, and comparing proposals that are not alike. Use this to evaluate an investment or major purchase, compare competing funding requests, set a hurdle rate, decide between building and buying, or review whether past investments delivered what was claimed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估投资与采购,合理分配每一笔资金
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要决定把钱投向哪个项目或评估一笔大额采购是否值得。
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate investments and allocate limited capital wisely.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must rank investment opportunities and set hurdle rates.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按增量现金流评估投资或采购提案，剔除沉没成本，计入机会成本与营运资本；用净现值做决策、用回收期衡量流动性风险，并要求明确责任人和事后复盘。
howto.when: 当你说要评估投资或大宗采购、比较多份资金申请、或设定门槛回报率时，Claude 会按这套资本配置框架处理。

say.text: 帮我评估这个设备采购值不值得投
比较这两个项目，哪个更值得用有限资金
say.note: Claude 会对比净现值、回收期和风险，给出建议。

say.text: 给这个新项目设定一个门槛回报率
say.note: Claude 会按项目特定风险来定，而不是一刀切。

howto.what_en: Claude appraises capital proposals on incremental cash flows, ignoring sunk costs, counting opportunity cost and working capital. It decides by NPV, uses payback for liquidity risk, and requires accountable owners and post-completion review.
howto.when_en: When you ask to evaluate an investment or major purchase, compare competing funding requests, or set a hurdle rate, Claude uses this capital-allocation framework.

say_en.text: Should we fund this equipment purchase?
say_en.note: Assesses incremental cash flows and flags exclusions.
Compares NPV, payback, and risk between the proposals.

say_en.text: Set a hurdle rate for this new project.
say_en.note: Sets a proposal-specific rate, not one that is company-wide.
